title: Price lists
list_description: Prices that differ from the base prices: a market's own, a sale, wholesale. A market can use several; shoppers get the lowest live price among them.
new_description: Prices that differ from the base prices, for the markets that use the list.
kind_sale_description: A reduction: shoppers see its price struck through against the regular price, and the product counts as on sale.
kind_override_description: The regular price where it applies (a market's own prices, wholesale): nothing is struck through unless a compare-at price says so.
adjustment_products: {percent} on {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}}
adjustment_categories: {percent} on {count, plural, one {# category} other {# categories}}
audience_groups_count: {count, plural, one {# customer group} other {# customer groups}}
fixed_prices_count: {count, plural, one {# fixed price} other {# fixed prices}}
template_sale_description: A reduction for a while: 20% off a category, from one date to another.
template_clearance_description: Sell off a category at a reduction, with no end date.
template_market_description: A market's own regular prices: an adjustment of every base price, and fixed prices for some.
template_wholesale_description: Fixed prices and quantity breaks for a customer group: pick the group under Audience.
list_empty_description: Without one, a market sells at the base prices. Make a list for a market's own prices, a sale or wholesale.
list_no_results: No price lists match these filters
form_name_description: For staff, unique: shown wherever the list is chosen.
form_currency_description_new: Fixed once it's created: its fixed prices are in it, and only markets in this currency can use it.
form_currency_description_fixed: Fixed: its fixed prices are in it.
form_eu_notice: Selling in the EU? During a reduction the price struck through must be the lowest of the last 30 days. Hypha doesn't track that yet: set the variants' compare-at prices (or the fixed prices' own) to it yourself.
form_compare_at_adjusted_description: A variant's compare-at price shows with the list's adjustment applied.
form_compare_at_hidden_description: Only a fixed price's own compare-at price shows.
form_schedule_description: Times are in the store's time zone, {timeZone}. Prices change at the moment it starts and ends; search and the storefront's pages follow within a minute.
form_active_description: A draft prices nothing, whatever its dates say: switch it off to pause the list.
form_date_time_invalid: Enter a date and a time.
form_end_before_start: The end must be after the start.
form_audience_description: Who it prices for. Without a group, every shopper. With groups, only signed-in customers in one of them: in their carts and on product pages once they sign in. Listings and search show everyone's prices.
form_audience_no_groups: Everyone. To price for some customers, make a <link>customer group</link> first.
form_adjustment_description: A percentage of the base price, for the products it covers. Variants with a fixed price in the list cost that instead. Without an adjustment, the list prices only the variants it has fixed prices for.
form_percentage_zero: 0: the base prices as they are.
form_percentage_reduction: {percent}: a reduction of the base price.
form_percentage_markup: {percent}: a markup of the base price.
form_percent_invalid: A percentage, like -20 for 20% off or 5 for 5% more (at most 100% off).
form_scope_categories_description: A category counts the products in its subcategories too.
form_categories_required: Choose the categories it applies to.
form_products_required: Choose the products it applies to.
form_start_from_description: A template fills in the settings a kind of list needs; change any of them below.
form_markets_description: Where it prices: the markets whose catalogs use it. A market can use several lists, and shoppers get the lowest live price among them, so a markup list (+20%) can't win beside a market's regular list. You can change this on the list's page later.
form_needs_fixing: Some settings need fixing: see the marked fields.
detail_attach_failed_title: The list was created, but not every market took it
detail_attach_failed_description: A market's catalog holds at most {max, number} lists, all in its currency. Add it to the markets missing under Markets below.
detail_prices_count: {count, plural, one {# fixed price} other {# fixed prices}} in {currency}
detail_editor_hint_write: The price editor shows every variant with its base price and the price this list gives it. Click a cell and type to set a fixed price, paste a column from a spreadsheet, or import a CSV.
detail_editor_hint_read: The price editor shows every variant with its base price and the price this list gives it.
delete_description: Its fixed prices go with it. Orders placed with its prices keep them.
delete_in_use: Used by {markets}. Remove it there (under "Markets" on this page), then delete it.
delete_confirm_description: The list and its fixed prices are deleted for good.
where_description: A market can use several lists: shoppers get the lowest live price among them. So put lists together only when they should compete; a markup (+20%) beside a market's regular list never wins.
where_none: No market uses it yet, so it prices nothing.
entry_compare_at_not_above_price: The compare-at price must be above the price.
entry_price_break_quantity_invalid: Break quantities start at 2 and go up.
entry_price_breaks_not_descending: Each break's price must be below the one before it, the first below the price.
entry_currency_mismatch: Prices must be in the list's currency.
candidate_tied_with_older: Loses: the same price as an older list, which wins the tie.
candidate_not_live_scheduled: Not live yet: its window hasn't started.
candidate_not_pricing: Doesn't price it: no fixed price, and its adjustment doesn't cover the product.
candidate_not_in_audience: Not for this buyer: it prices only for other customer groups.
break_quantity_not_increasing: Quantities must increase ({quantity, number} after {previous, number}).
break_price_not_below_fixed: The price from {quantity, number} must be below the fixed price.
break_price_not_below_previous: The price from {quantity, number} must be below the one before it.
draft_needs_fixed_price: Needs a fixed price, or clear the row.
draft_compare_at_not_above: Must be above the fixed price.
grid_cells_skipped: {count, plural, one {# cell} other {# cells}} couldn't take a value and kept theirs.
grid_fix_cells: Fix the cells marked in red, then save.
grid_rows_not_saved: {count, plural, one {# variant wasn't} other {# variants weren't}} saved: see the rows marked.
grid_changed: {count, plural, one {# variant} other {# variants}} changed
grid_changed_to_fix: {count, plural, one {# variant} other {# variants}} changed, {errors, number} to fix
grid_read_only: Your role can see these prices but not change them.
grid_hint: Click a cell and type. {enter} to edit, {tab} or arrows to move, {save} to save.
grid_leave_description: {count, plural, one {# variant has} other {# variants have}} changes that aren't saved. Leaving drops them.
bulk_amount_subtitle: Sets {count, plural, one {the selected price} other {the # selected prices}} to one amount in {currency}.
bulk_percent_title: Set to a percentage of base
bulk_percent_subtitle: Sets {count, plural, one {the selected price} other {the # selected prices}} to each variant's base price adjusted: -10 is 10% off, 5 is 5% more. Rounded as checkout rounds.
breaks_dialog_no_fixed: Breaks need a fixed price: set one in the grid first.
breaks_dialog_fixed: Below the first break, each costs the fixed price, {amount} {currency}.
breaks_dialog_none: No breaks: every quantity costs the same.
editor_filters_locked: Save or discard to change filters
editor_variants_on_page: {count, plural, one {# variant} other {# variants}} on this page
editor_next_page_locked: Save or discard your changes first
editor_empty_fixed_only_hint: Only variants with a fixed price in this list are shown. Turn off “Fixed prices only” to set new ones.
editor_empty_hint: Products you add show here with their prices.
import_subtitle: Rows are matched by {column}, else SKU, else handle and options, against every product. Nothing is written until you apply.
import_too_large: That file is over {megabytes, number} MB. Split it into smaller files.
import_media_not_configured: Imports go through media storage, and this store has none set up. Configure media storage, then import again.
import_upload_missing: The upload didn't finish. Try again.
import_upload_expired: The uploaded file has expired. Import it again.
import_not_stored: The file didn't reach storage. Check your connection and try again.
import_check_failed: The file couldn't be checked. Try again.
import_reading: Reading the file and matching its rows…
import_nothing_to_change: Nothing to change: every matched row has the prices the list has.
import_summary: Applying sets {upserts, number} and removes {clears, number} {changes, plural, one {fixed price} other {fixed prices}}. Unmatched and invalid rows are left out.
import_more_rows: {count, plural, one {And # more row like this.} other {And # more rows like these.}}
import_applied: Applied: {count, plural, one {# fixed price} other {# fixed prices}} changed.
import_failed_description: The rest were. Fix these rows and import the file again: rows already applied show as unchanged.
import_no_id_column: The file needs a {variant_id}, {sku} or {handle} column to find each variant.
import_sku_ambiguous: SKU {sku} is on {count, plural, one {# variant} other {# variants}}: add {column}.
import_options_required: {handle} has options: fill in the {column} column.
import_no_identifier: No {column}, SKU or handle to find the variant by.
import_break_incomplete: Break {number, number} needs both a quantity and a price.
